environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'data-plane-hardened' with a custom seccomp profile loaded via the Kubernetes SecurityContext annotation (seccomp type: Localhost, localhostProfile: profiles/resource-fetcher-strict.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode and explicitly blocks the 'connect' syscall (syscall number 42 on x86_64) for any socket address family other than AF_UNIX (family 1). Additionally, the profile blocks 'socket' syscall invocations where the first argument (domain) is AF_INET (2) or AF_INET6 (10) when the destination falls within RFC 1918 ranges or link-local (169.254.0.0/16), enforced via a BPF filter attached to the seccomp notification. The pod also has a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy with egressDeny rules matching CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports, and a separate egressDeny for 10.0.0.0/8 except for port 443 to the Kubernetes API server endpoint. The node uses IMDSv2 (HttpTokens: required, HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1).

config.node_metadata: IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 (container cannot reach)
